changelog: Improvements have been made to the AFK system.
Improvements have been made to the statistics details.
Added a global configuration option to enable or disable user notifications (notify).
Added notification (notify) export support for resources such as ox_lib. See the config for details.
Added customization for changing the /szone command used to open the NUI. See the config for details.
Server-side improvements have been made, and an export position setting for ox_lib has been added.
Improvements have been made to the AFK system. A captcha system has been added. If the user fails the captcha verification, the time counter will stop.
Added the /szonefix command to resolve cases where the NUI screen may remain open. The command can be customized through the config.
The entire design has been changed.
Improved compatibility with older inventory systems.
Added Turkish and English language support.
Fixed item rewards not being given on some servers.
Improved compatibility with different QBCore versions.
Item rewards that cannot be delivered are no longer lost; they are kept until they can be given.
Added a debug mode for easier troubleshooting.
